limitations: Descends from unreleased M4 candidate 619b23f27548dbd821b511f27a02b084d9d2ac63 but not from the M2 or M3 candidates required by issue 4721.
Does not descend from the current M0/M1 PR head and none of its runtime dependencies exist on protected main.
The objective estimates one independent camera pose block from already-known world points; no shared unknown target poses couple cameras into a flexible-layout bundle adjustment.
The claimed robust PnP initialization evaluates all points and leave-one-out sets only, so multiple outliers have no deterministic consensus/rejection contract.
The DLT initializer requires rank-eleven non-planar geometry and does not support ordinary planar calibration targets.
There is no versioned JSON Schema, canonical golden serialization, public export baseline, or immutable consumer fixture.
Returned soft-loss residuals do not identify accepted and rejected observations with stable reason codes.
Layout continuity compares caller-supplied poses without measurement uncertainty, timestamps, evidence provenance, relocalization, or an executable recalibration workflow.

dependencies.blocking_evidence: Authority ADRs and acceptance matrix are absent from protected main; PR 4734 is open and conflicting.
Canonical device, frame, uncertainty, availability, and provenance schemas are absent from protected main.
The acquisition/provider candidate is local-only and is not an ancestor of the M5 candidate.
The timing/provenance candidate is local-only, has incorrect sibling topology relative to M2, and is not an ancestor of M5.
The current-main M4 reconciliation is an audit-only source slice and explicitly publishes no intrinsic runtime.

required_sequence.action: Protected-qualify and merge PR 4753, or incorporate its sparse downstream contract repair into a newly reviewed M0/M1 replacement.
Rebuild and protected-merge TOOLS-M0 and TOOLS-M1 from then-current main, freezing frames, transforms, units, uncertainty, availability, provenance, and serialization.
Rebuild and protected-merge TOOLS-M2 on the exact M1 release, exposing bounded captured-frame, target-observation, cancellation, and provider contracts.
Rebuild and protected-merge TOOLS-M3 on the exact M2 release, preserving clock, synchronization uncertainty, sequence, drop/duplicate, and recording provenance facts.
Amend and implement TOOLS-M4 on the exact M3 release, then protected-merge intrinsic, detector/provider, observation, rejection, uncertainty, and quality authority.
Rebuild TOOLS-M5 from then-current protected main and the exact M4 release using contract-first flexible-layout tests; do not cherry-pick f371ce4.
After protected M5 release, publish immutable sanitized schemas and fixtures for AffineDrift 3962 parity, then qualify downstream layout consumers.

planned_m5.state_model: Jointly estimate arbitrary camera poses and per-capture target poses from metric target geometry, with a single explicit gauge policy and deterministic parameter ordering.
planned_m5.initialization: Versioned planar homography and non-planar PnP initialization with bounded deterministic consensus, declared seed, inlier mask, chirality checks, and typed failure.
planned_m5.optimization: Bounded robust bundle adjustment over shared camera and target-pose variables; returned status includes termination, active bounds, accepted/rejected observations, and residual provenance.
planned_m5.observability: Graph-connectivity, gauge-nullspace, Jacobian-rank, baseline/view-diversity, depth, and conditioning checks must fail closed with stable reason codes.
planned_m5.uncertainty_contract: Gauge-aware joint covariance and camera marginals/cross-covariances with names, frames, units, effective rank, conditioning, intrinsic-uncertainty policy, and PSD validation.
planned_m5.movement_contract: Relocalization observations with timestamps and uncertainty drive SE(3) change evidence; missing, added, moved, ambiguous, or stale cameras invalidate inference authority explicitly.
planned_m5.recalibration_contract: A versioned state machine separates suspected movement, invalidation, candidate recalibration, human approval, activation, rollback, and immutable layout segments.
planned_m5.provenance_contract: Bind M2/M3/M4 source identities, frame and target-definition digests, solver/config versions, input observation IDs, exclusion reasons, timestamps, approval, and output digest.
planned_m5.schema_and_fixture: Strict JSON Schema and canonical golden serialization with unknown-field, unknown-version, non-finite, oversize, and digest rejection plus an immutable sanitized consumer fixture.
required_tests: two-camera and arbitrary-N flexible target-pose recovery
multiple-outlier consensus and typed observation rejection
disconnected, scale-free, collinear, low-baseline, and rank-deficient rejection
uncertainty coverage and covariance permutation invariance
camera addition, removal, translation, rotation, stale evidence, and ambiguity invalidation
recalibration approval, activation, rollback, and segment immutability
resource caps, cancellation, deterministic ordering, and canonical serialization
